title: PixzFlow Adaptation State
description: Runtime-level self-learning state — the post-install continuity substrate of PixzFlow 2.1. Complements (never replaces) the per-task schemas/task-state.schema.json: task-state tracks ONE task; adaptation-state tracks the runtime's relationship with the installed PixzFlow workflow (baseline, activation, drift, verified learning). Default path: .pixz/adaptation-state.json. Compact and machine-readable: summaries + references only — never transcripts, never hidden chain-of-thought, never unnecessary user information. Entries admitted to learning[] require verification evidence (Voyager lesson: only verified artifacts enter the persistent library).

runtime.description: Observed runtime profile (baseline dimensions). Record only what was actually observed; use "unknown" otherwise.

name.description: claude | openclaw | opencode | hermes | codex | cursor | generic | <other>

signals.description: Observable identity signals used to recognize the runtime (paths found, CLIs present, self-report).

instruction_sources.description: How the runtime reaches PixzFlow: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md@import, skills dir, etc.

session.description: Session/context characteristics relevant to persistence (compaction observed? restartable? subagents available?).

source.description: Where it came from: repo URL + SHA/tag, skills.sh, manual copy.

dimensions.description: Capability baseline (mission §6). Values: yes | no | unknown — observed, not assumed.

state_persistence.description: Can this runtime keep files across sessions (filesystem .pixz/)?

verification.description: Can the agent run commands/tests to verify claims?

tools.description: Compact inventory of relevant tools/CLIs observed.

unknowns.description: Observed gaps — capabilities that remain UNKNOWN rather than invented.

inventory.description: Installed capability snapshot with content digests — the drift detector. digest = sha256(SKILL.md + 0x00 + metadata.yaml) computed by scripts/activation.py.

installed.description: Discovery command showed it at its install location (not merely present in source).

verified.description: Installation verified with evidence per the install protocol.

status.description: baselined = inventory+baseline recorded, behavioral adaptation not yet verified; ready = adaptation verified with evidence; stale = drift detected since last adaptation (re-adapt the delta, then sync).

evidence.description: What verified the adaptation (command output refs, eval ids, observed behavior). Required to reach ready.

learning.description: Persistent learning ledger. Admit only: stable lessons, verified mechanisms, important failures, validated decisions, reusable procedures, known constraints, open unknowns. Status discipline mirrors the claim lifecycle: nothing here is 'learned' by assertion.

lesson.description: One or two lines: what the next run must not repeat / should reuse.

status.description: candidate = observed once; stable = recurred or verified; superseded = replaced (marked, never deleted).

kind.description: Deliberately NOT: new skill, new agent, new schema, new dependency — those require the anti-proliferation gate first.

status.description: proposed → challenged (six challenges) → implemented → verified (regression check passed) ; regressed/rejected are terminal-with-reason.

challenge_outcome.description: How it survived: failure / regression / overfitting / complexity / confirmation / adversarial challenges.

verification.description: Evidence that it works at the claimed depth (verification-depth ladder).

regression_check.description: What existing behavior was re-tested after the change.

history.description: Compact event log (keep <= 50 entries; prune oldest). Not a transcript.
